# S69 — Household timezone in the planner views

Make the planning page and the list generation use the configured household timezone for "today", as the Today view does.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:** web

**Not in this slice:** any new setting. `Settings.timezone` already exists.

## Why

`home_views.today(settings)` returns the date in `settings.timezone` (host local time when unset). `plan_views.today` is `date.today`, and the S24 generation follows the planner's host-local convention, so on a host whose clock is not in the household's timezone the three can disagree around midnight. Found in the S21 and S24 reviews.

## Owner input

None. The household timezone is `Settings.timezone`, as ADR 0013's Saturday-evening session implies.

- `src/larder/web/plan_views.py`
- `src/larder/shopping/generate.py` (wherever generation reads today's date; re-anchor at start)
